title: EasyUpdateSuppressor
description: This plugin allows players to do update suppression without setting up large contraption in new version of Minecraft.
body:
A simple update suppressor plugin for Minecraft 26.1 or above.

Support Spigot and it's downstreams servers.

Player can toggle the plugin by entering command /togglesuppressor (no permisssion is needed)

Plugin compiled in Java 21

Demo Video: https://youtu.be/8Sw6ywHpSkM
